$meta.name: CivicDataSpace Design Tokens
$meta.description: Canonical, machine-readable source of truth for CivicDataSpace design tokens. Values reflect the WCAG 2.2 AA color and typography remediation (accessibility audit, 2026-09-07) merged on top of the CSS-audited baseline. All colors are solid hex — where the baseline used oklch(), the hex is the exact OKLab→sRGB conversion. The Tailwind v4 theme in src/generated/tokens.css is GENERATED from this file via `npm run gen:tokens`; do not hand-edit that file. design-system.md is also generated from this file.

color.$description: Base + brand + semantic color roles. Each key K produces the CSS custom property --K (kebab-cased) in :root and, unless listed in the generator's root-only set (ringOnDark, borderStrong), the Tailwind utility color --color-K via @theme inline.

base.$description: Radix-style base color ramps, reconciled with the DataSpaceFrontend token naming convention. Every value here is a var() reference to an existing entry in `color` above — no hex is duplicated or changed. Root-only: these never get a Tailwind utility key, matching the convention that components consume the semantic (text/border/surface/action) layer below, never the raw base ramp directly.

text.$description: Semantic text-color roles, aliasing the base ramp above. Each key K produces --text-<kebab(K)> and the Tailwind utility --color-text-<kebab(K)> (usable as e.g. text-text-default — the doubled 'text' is a known, accepted consequence of Tailwind's `text-` utility prefix matching this family's own name; the existing border/ring tokens already do the same thing, e.g. border-border, ring-ring).

border.$description: Semantic border-color roles, aliasing the base ramp above. Each key K produces --border-<kebab(K)> and the Tailwind utility --color-border-<kebab(K)> (usable as e.g. border-border-default — see the note on the `text` group about the doubled prefix). `strong` is deliberately omitted here: the existing `color.borderStrong` entry already produces the identical CSS variable name (--border-strong) — see COLOR_ROOT_ONLY in the generator, which now gives it a Tailwind key too instead of duplicating the declaration.

uiSurface.$description: Semantic UI-state surface roles (distinct from the app-chrome `surface` group below), aliasing the base ramp/existing color tokens. Each key K produces --surface-<kebab(K)> and --color-surface-<kebab(K)> (usable as e.g. bg-surface-default).

action.$description: Composite semantic tokens for interactive elements (Button/Badge), aliasing the text/border/surface layers above. Each key K produces --action-<kebab(K)> and --color-action-<kebab(K)> (usable as e.g. bg-action-primary-default).

chart.$description: Categorical data-viz palette — amber-to-brown ramp, each stop ≥ 3:1 on white. Key N produces --chart-N and --color-chart-N. chart-1 no longer aliases accent.

sidebar.$description: Sidebar surface scope. `DEFAULT` produces --sidebar / --color-sidebar; other keys produce --sidebar-<key> / --color-sidebar-<key>. Still unused by ContributorSidebar.tsx.

surface.$description: App-chrome surfaces that sit outside the shadcn base set. Key K produces --<kebab(K)> and --color-<kebab(K)>. workspaceHeroFrom/To are the two stops of the Dashboard 'My Workspace' panel wash — compose the gradient inline: linear-gradient(252deg, var(--workspace-hero-from) 0%, var(--workspace-hero-to) 97.53%).

font.$description: Font stacks. Key K produces --font-K in :root and the Tailwind --font-K theme key. Inter is loaded at weights 400–700 (300 dropped); JetBrains Mono at 400–500.

radius.$description: Border-radius scale. `DEFAULT` produces the --radius base custom property only (no Tailwind key, matching current implementation). sm/md/lg/xl produce --radius-<key> in :root and the Tailwind --radius-<key> theme key, and are expressed relative to --radius so the scale stays proportional.
